sources.why: TechRadar tested UGreen Uno 100W for MacBook, iPhone, AirPods at once
sources.evidence: 100W is enough to fast-charge most MacBook Pro models, and is available if you’re using single port charging. However, there are three more ports onboard

sources.why: WIRED tested 30+ stations; Mophie 4-in-1 covers MacBook, phone, watch, AirPods
sources.evidence: What elevates it is the retractable USB-C cable that unfurls from the back and can deliver up to 60 watts.

sources.why: MacBook charger guide; wired multiport, not a station with Qi2
sources.evidence: 100W is enough to charge a MacBook and an iPhone or iPad and maybe enough to power up your Apple Watch or AirPods case while you’re at it.

sources.why: Macworld tested MagSafe stands incl. 4-in-1 with MacBook output
